Large 1000 sq foot apartment, featuring 2 bedrooms + den and 2 bathrooms  in beautiful Kitsilano available for September 16.

This apartment is centrally located, with a short walk to grocery shops, restaurants, cafes, Kitsilano community centre, and local library, local high schools and more.

Key features:
- Engineered hardwood throughout
- Stainless steel appliances
- Gas fireplace
- Underground parking and bike storage
- Secure storage room
- Outdoor area for bbqing

Please note - all applicants will be subject to a reference and credit check.
